note: Reel 31: The Last 1,000 (working title), episode 1 of a voted serial. Draft 6. Narrator: af_heart. Meera and Ravi are character voices chosen by audition; x01-x04 audition how 'Amma' is said and are not placed. Fiction; the bible is docs/research.md.
ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: You can save the last doctor on Earth, or the last engineer. Not both.
Your parents have been asking you this for years, and now you've got five seconds.
Stop. That isn't their mother they're shouting for. It's you.
You're the ship they're drowning in, and the last thousand people alive call you Amma.
lines.text_kokoro: You're the ship they're drowning in, and the last thousand people alive call you [Amma](/ˈʌmmɑː/).

lines.text: Ten seconds as their mother, and you're still picking by degree.
You've got power for one door, no time for another, and everyone watching this gets a vote.
Open hers, and the only man who can run you drowns, and a fifteen-year-old has forty days to learn how, or you all sink.
But Meera and Ravi are married, and you gave the bride away yourself.
lines.text_kokoro: But [Meera](/mˈiːɹɑː/) and [Ravi](/ɹˈʌvi/) are married, and you gave the bride away yourself.

lines.text: And she's carrying the only baby since the world ended.
Open his, and you're safe, with no doctor, no baby, and he spends the rest of his life fixing you.
